title: The ordinary pullback completion map is the strict quotient unit
statement: For prime l and finite E/Q_l, every scheme morphism f:X→Y, and every normalized strict pullback model p [def-sf-pull-completion-comparison], the ordinary forward completion transformation IntegralOrdinary.pullComparison of [lem-sf-integral-ordinary-pullback-comparison] equals p.unit. No tensor, constructibility, Noetherian, or invertibility condition is imposed.

proof.text: Choose the already proved cochain pullback identification, with its inverse-unit section formula and derived computation-map formula.

The normalized strict pullback tower has the prescribed effect on quotient-unit generators. Transport through the module isomorphism and apply uniqueness of the ordinary quotient augmentation. The product lifts agree; naturality of mapping-cocone lifts, with zero shifted coordinate, identifies the entire completion chain.

Uniqueness of derived functors preserves their computation maps. On a good representative apply the defining equations for ordinary completion, the strict pullback model and the completion unit. The chain identity gives equality after the representative comparison.
Cancel the representative comparison and use faithful restriction along the good-complex localization.
